items.text: Franck, attended Heathfield School, an all-girls boarding school close to Ascot in England, and studied the history of art from the age of 14

"In those days she took us on outings to London, which was the big excitement of the year for me." == Career == Franck studied art history at the University of Madrid and at the Ecole du Louvre in Paris
